top_signals.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 8
top_signals.summary: Brent oil held gains near $100 a barrel as traders watched for details of an Iranian deal with Oman to manage shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, while strong Chinese buying tightened the market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Naomi Osaka takes major title wait in stride after U.S. Open exit
top_signals.summary: The Japanese player won the last of her four major titles in 2021 before stepping away from the sport and giving birth to her daughter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Canada Imposes Tariffs Up to 50% on the US
top_signals.summary: Canada imposed tariffs of 15% to 50% on hundreds of products from the US as Prime Minister Mark Carney bets that standing up to President Donald Trump will help Ottawa's negotiating position. Bloomberg's Rosalind Mathieson has the context. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: The crisis for Merz and the CDU
top_signals.summary: ‘Giving up is not an option for me,’ says German chancellor as AfD routs conservatives in eastern stronghold

top_signals.title: GPIF still considering need for asset allocation review, minister says
top_signals.summary: With the fund overseeing about ¥318 trillion in assets, a 1 percentage-point change in allocations translates to more than ¥3 trillion in fund flows.
